function:public.identity_invitation_invi.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.identity_invitation_inviter(invitation_id bigint)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$SELECT inviter.id FROM public.household_invitations i JOIN public.household_memberships m ON m.id=i.invited_by_membership_id AND m.household_id=i.household_id JOIN public.accounts inviter ON inviter.person_id=m.person_id WHERE i.id=invitation_id AND lower(i.email::text)=(SELECT lower(a.email) FROM public.accounts a WHERE a.id=med_tracker.current_account_id() AND a.status=2)$function$

function:public.native_account_email_cha.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.native_account_email_changed()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$ BEGIN
  UPDATE public.users SET email_address=NEW.email,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE person_id=NEW.person_id;
  INSERT INTO public.pg_loco_queue(id,task_data,name,run_at,priority)
  VALUES(public.gen_random_uuid()::text,
    jsonb_build_object('from',NULL,'to',OLD.email,'reply_to',NULL,'subject','Email address changed',
      'text','Your MedTracker email address was changed. If this was not you, secure your account immediately.',
      'html','','bcc',NULL,'cc',NULL,'headers',NULL),
    'MailerWorker',clock_timestamp(),100);
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

function:public.native_account_verificat.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.native_account_verification_status()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$ BEGIN
  IF NEW.email_verified AND NOT OLD.email_verified AND OLD.status = 1 THEN NEW.status := 2; END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

policy:public.household_invitations.iden.using:
((accepted_at IS NULL) AND (revoked_at IS NULL) AND (expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (lower((email)::text) = ( SELECT lower(a.email) AS lower
   FROM accounts a
  WHERE ((a.id = med_tracker.current_account_id()) AND (a.status = 2) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM account_lockouts l
          WHERE ((l.account_id = a.id) AND (l.deadline > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)))))))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM identity_sessions s
  WHERE ((s.account_id = med_tracker.current_account_id()) AND (s.token = NULLIF(current_setting('med_tracker.identity_session_token'::text, true), ''::text)) AND s.active AND (s.purpose = 'authenticated'::text) AND (s.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)))))

policy:public.household_memberships.iden.using:

  WHERE ((i.invited_by_membership_id = household_memberships.id) AND (i.accepted_at IS NULL) AND (i.revoked_at IS NULL) AND (i.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (lower((i.email)::text) = ( SELECT lower(a.email) AS lower
           FROM accounts a

trigger:public.accounts.native_account_a.definition: CREATE TRIGGER native_account_audit AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.accounts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION native_authentication_audit()

trigger:public.accounts.native_account_e.definition: CREATE TRIGGER native_account_email_changed AFTER UPDATE OF email ON public.accounts FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((old.email IS DISTINCT FROM new.email)) EXECUTE FUNCTION native_account_email_changed()

trigger:public.accounts.native_account_v.definition: CREATE TRIGGER native_account_verification_status BEFORE UPDATE OF email_verified ON public.accounts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION native_account_verification_status()

trigger:public.accounts.native_factor_no.definition: CREATE TRIGGER native_factor_notice AFTER UPDATE OF two_factor_enabled ON public.accounts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION native_authentication_notice()

trigger:public.auth_credentials.native_c.definition: CREATE TRIGGER native_credential_audit AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.auth_credentials FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION native_authentication_audit()

trigger:public.identity_api_keys.native_.definition: CREATE TRIGGER native_api_key_create_audit AFTER INSERT ON public.identity_api_keys FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((new.config_id = 'medtracker-personal'::text)) EXECUTE FUNCTION native_authentication_audit()
CREATE TRIGGER native_api_key_create_notice AFTER INSERT ON public.identity_api_keys FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((new.config_id = 'medtracker-personal'::text)) EXECUTE FUNCTION native_authentication_notice()
CREATE TRIGGER native_api_key_delete_audit AFTER DELETE ON public.identity_api_keys FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((old.config_id = 'medtracker-personal'::text)) EXECUTE FUNCTION native_authentication_audit()

CREATE TRIGGER native_api_key_revoke_notice AFTER UPDATE OF enabled ON public.identity_api_keys FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((new.config_id = 'medtracker-personal'::text) AND old.enabled AND (NOT new.enabled))) EXECUTE FUNCTION native_authentication_notice()

CREATE TRIGGER native_api_key_update_audit AFTER UPDATE OF enabled ON public.identity_api_keys FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((new.config_id = 'medtracker-personal'::text) AND (old.enabled IS DISTINCT FROM new.enabled))) EXECUTE FUNCTION native_authentication_audit()
